CC: Dialer (iOS)

Quick Reference Guide

| This Quick Reference Guide (QRG) shows how to use the Dialer to place calls in the PerfectServe Clinical Collaboration (CC) Mobile Application for iOS. |
| :---: |

| Dialer This feature provides a secure method for you to place outbound calls to patients and other providers. Keypad – Free form keypad to dial any 10-digit number Call log – A list of all recently dialed numbers Settings – Adjust your call settings preferences  \*When placing a call within CC your personal number will be masked. IMPORTANT \- If you click a hyperlinked number from a CC message that call will not mask your personal number.  ![][image1]          ![][image2]   |  |
